criteria.description: The quest starts normally in a controllable third-person village state.
Village, connecting route, and ruin are visibly distinct, authored, navigable places with useful landmarks and collision.
Approaching the warden exposes readable dialogue and an explicit accept action that changes both objective tracking and later NPC dialogue.

Visible targeting and range feedback support a basic attack, damage ability, and heal or defense ability with real cooldown/resource constraints; at least two enemy roles create different threats and defensive or healing decisions visibly improve survival.
At least two distinguishable enemy roles pursue and attack without hitting through walls or after death, and the relic visibly drops only after all three required defeats and must be collected.
The player must return to the warden with the collected relic and explicitly turn in for reward and victory; combat or pickup alone cannot complete the quest.
Quest stage, world cues, dialogue, target frame, cooldowns, health/resource, loot, reward, and current objective agree and remain readable.
At 390 x 844 move, camera, target, interact, attack, and both ability controls support the quest chain without UI overlap.
